cost_frontier.interpretation: Within each environment, common task scope and currency, select the lowest complete mean cost among tested model/policy configurations that attain the quality lower bound. This is not a Pareto set or cost per success. Selection on confirmation data is not independent confirmation of the selected winner.

cost.reason: Missing, unpriced or mixed currency costs

limitations: Model quality uses verified business success and applicable contracts; unknown earns no success credit.
Invalid runs and replacements retain their own costs. Missing planned slots prevent complete quality estimates.
Cluster Hoeffding intervals are conservative and assume independent declared clusters. Repeats do not create new clusters.
Input ratio inference needs an independently verified preregistered bound; missing bounds never yield noninferiority.
No reanalysis can create a new model execution, unseen confirmation or a missing model-by-environment cell.

model_environment_interaction.interpretation: Paired four-cell quality, capped-time and complete currency-cost contrasts, averaged within cases before cluster inference. Exploratory combinations do not become confirmation claims.

claim_ledger.allocation: Bonferroni over this outcome-independent ledger, retaining the registered primary-family floor. A ratio divides its allocation between its two bounded means.

statistical_policy.inference_unit: cluster_id; cases and repeats remain nested
